definitions.explanation: A Japanese dish consisting of vinegared rice combined with various ingredients, typically raw fish, seafood, vegetables, or egg.

examples.japanese: {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}に{行|い}きませんか。
examples.english: Shall we go to a conveyor belt sushi restaurant?
examples.notes: Note the rendaku: すし becomes ずし in compounds

examples.japanese: {握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}を{十|じゅっ}{貫|かん}{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered ten pieces of nigiri sushi.

examples.japanese: {新鮮|しんせん}なネタの{寿司|すし}は{格別|かくべつ}だ。
examples.english: Sushi with fresh toppings is exceptional.
examples.notes: ネタ means the topping/ingredient on sushi

notes:
Also written as {鮨|すし} or {鮓|すし}. Types include:
- {握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし} (hand-pressed sushi)
- {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし} (rolled sushi)
- {押|お}し{寿司|ずし} (pressed sushi)
- {散|ち}らし{寿司|ずし} (scattered sushi)
- {手巻|てま}き{寿司|ずし} (hand rolls)

Sushi terminology:
- シャリ (vinegared rice)
- ネタ (topping)
- ガリ (pickled ginger)
- むらさき (soy sauce - sushi shop term)
- あがり (green tea - sushi shop term)

Counter: {一貫|いっかん}, {二貫|にかん}... (pieces of nigiri).
